title: Privacy policy
description: Who processes your data, why, on what legal basis, for how long, who it is shared with and how to exercise your rights (GDPR and Spanish LOPDGDD).

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of the personal data collected on josecoded.com is:
items: Owner: {{DATO: full name of the owner}}
Tax ID (NIF): {{DATO: tax ID of the owner}}
Address: {{DATO: registered address of the owner}}

sections.heading: What data I process and why
paragraphs: I only process the data you give me or that your use of the site generates, for these purposes:
items: Answering your enquiry: name, email, phone (if you give it), company and the message of the contact or agency form, and the details of a call booking.

Preparing a rough proposal: your answers in the proposal generator. The AI classifies what you need; the price is calculated by rules from the published rates. No decision with legal effects is taken by the AI alone.
Your account and the client area: your email to sign in without a password, your language and the origin you arrived from, to personalise the start of the area.
Referral attribution (referral programme): the code of whoever recommended you, to credit the recommendation and detect self-referrals.
Chat with the assistant: the messages you write and a per-IP quota to prevent abuse.
Security and improving the site: an anti-robot check and aggregate statistics without cookies or personal identifiers.

sections.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: Enquiry and proposal: pre-contractual measures at your request and, where applicable, your consent. Account and client area: performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures. Referrals: your consent when you accept the cookie. Security and statistics: legitimate interest in protecting the site and understanding its use in aggregate.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: I keep the data while I handle your enquiry or the relationship lasts and, afterwards, for the legal limitation periods. If no relationship follows: {{DATO: retention period for enquiries without a relationship}}.

sections.heading: Recipients and processors
paragraphs: I do not sell your data. To provide the service I use providers that act as processors:
items: Supabase: database and accounts, in a project hosted in the European Union.
Cloudflare: hosting and network of the site, anti-robot check (Turnstile) and AI models (Workers AI).
Cal.com: call booking, only if you use it.
Notification tools: they tell me about new enquiries by messaging and email.

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. They then do so with adequate safeguards, such as an adequacy decision or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability, and withdraw your consent, by writing to {{DATO: email to exercise rights}}. You can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) if you believe your rights have not been respected.

sections.heading: Minors
paragraphs: The site is not aimed at minors.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes it will be updated here with the date of the last change. The Spanish version is the legally binding one; the English one is a courtesy translation.
